notes: Printed -7 emblem: 'At the beginning of combat on your turn, put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. It gains haste.' Turn 1 (mine): the opponent's Opp Beast comes back under my control with haste and attacks for 2 (20 -> 18); it is then killed and goes back to its owner's graveyard. Turn 2 is the opponent's: their beginning of combat does not trigger my emblem. Turn 3 (mine): the emblem triggers again, the Beast returns under my control with haste and attacks for 2 more (18 -> 16).
